description: Game speed: from the front door, the dialog presses of postwick, then the stick up for 60 frames (2 s at 30 fps). The final shot is matched against walkspeed_ref: 30 and 60 fps must stop at the same point (21/10: both at ~64 frames of the reference); uncapped (LARECOMP_FPS=0) stopped there too in a third of the time (3x)
